description: Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the rental it pays for.

b.request: For payments with a non-NULL rental_id, sum amount by the staff_id on the linked rental, and show each staff_id, its total amount, and its share of the combined total across those staff members, without rounding
b.sql:
SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM payment p
JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.staff_id;

a.request: Considering only payments that link to a rental record, credit each payment to the staff member who handled that rental (`rental.staff_id`). For each such staff member, return the staff ID, the total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff members. Do not round anything.
a.sql: SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON r2.rental_id = p2.rental_id) AS fraction_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id

c.request: For payments that link to a rental, how much payment revenue does each staff member bring in? Show the staff ID, their total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff. No rounding. Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the rental it pays for.
c.sql: SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON r2.rental_id = p2.rental_id) AS fraction_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id

d.request: For payments linked to a rental, credit each payment to the staff member recorded on that rental. For each staff member, show their ID, total payment amount, and that total as a fraction of the combined payment total across all staff. Do not round.
d.sql: SELECT s.staff_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment) AS fraction_of_all_payments FROM staff s LEFT JOIN rental r ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY s.staff_id
